name: xo-tag-automation
description: Tag-based VM automation for Xen Orchestra — performance tiers, group assignment, resource set management, and CSV import/export via VM tags
author: john olsen

tagSuffix.title: Tag Suffix
tagSuffix.description: Pool-specific suffix appended to performance tags (e.g. -v for POOL-V). Leave blank for generic.

schedule.title: Enforcement Schedule
schedule.description: How often to automatically run enabled modules.

dryRun.title: Dry Run Mode
dryRun.description: Preview all changes without applying them. Check XO logs to see output. Recommended for first run.

enablePerformance.title: Enable Performance Enforcement
enablePerformance.description: Apply CPU weights and IO priorities based on VM performance tier tags (0-core, 1-high, 2-normal, 3-low).

enablePermissions.title: Enable Permission Sync
enablePermissions.description: Watcher-only: assigns VMs to existing Groups and Resource Sets matching VM_{Dept}-Admin/Operator/Viewer tags. Never creates Groups or Resource Sets.

enableCsvAutoExport.title: Enable Scheduled CSV Auto-Export
enableCsvAutoExport.description: Automatically export VM metadata CSV on each scheduled run.

csvPath.title: CSV File Path
csvPath.description: Full path to the VM metadata CSV file. NFS-accessible path recommended.

performanceTiers.title: Performance Tier Settings
performanceTiers.description: CPU weights and IO priorities per tier. Mirrors default.conf values — override only what you need.
